responsibility: This is the central umbrella header for the gfortran front end. It defines the core enums, macros, data-structure interfaces, shared constants, and cross-module function prototypes used throughout parsing, semantic analysis, diagnostics, intrinsic handling, module I/O, OpenMP/OpenACC support, and translation, and it also establishes Fortran-specific diagnostic formatting conventions before GCC diagnostic headers are included.
same_name_distinction: This is the internal umbrella header consumed by the gfortran source code, defining shared front-end types, macros, enums, and cross-file prototypes. Unlike gcc/fortran/gfortran.texi, it is not user documentation but the compiler’s central internal interface.
